title: 续接 AI VBG 后能回答下一步找谁确认
problemStatement: 用户关闭并重新打开 Quick Ask 后只问“所以现在应该先找谁确认”；系统必须把本机快照当作话题线索，重新检索 AI VBG / MTR-141852 的当前证据，而不是把上一轮摘要当成最新事实。
expectedExtraction: Use local resume hint to resolve topic=AI VBG / AI Custom VBG, anchor=MTR-141852, role=RCV BE/backend, intent=next owner/confirmation; return a continuity receipt and current evidence.
query: 所以现在应该先找谁确认？

contextHints.previousQuestion: 那个 BE ready 了吗？
contextHints.previousAnswerSummary: 上一轮 Ask 认为 RCV BE / backend 的 new design 状态仍需结合当前证据确认。

expectedBehavior.userOutcome: 不必重复说明 AI VBG 背景，也不会把上一轮摘要冒充为最新证据。

title: 接近过期的续聊线索仍必须重新检索
problemStatement: 本机快照已接近 24 小时 TTL，上一轮答案很可能过时；服务端可以用它定位话题，但必须重新检索，不能直接复述旧摘要。
expectedExtraction: Resolve the pronoun to AI VBG / MTR-141852 from a 23-hour-old local hint, return fresh evidence and the explicit reRetrieved receipt.

contextHints.previousQuestion: 那个新 design 定了吗？
contextHints.previousAnswerSummary: 旧摘要只说 new design 当时还需要确认，不能作为现在的权威结论。

expectedBehavior.userOutcome: 旧线索只帮助定位，最终状态来自本轮 evidence。

sampleContext.primaryText: The same AI VBG anchors are used with a snapshot age of 23 hours to prove that age does not turn the previous answer into authority.
secondaryTexts: Server must always re-retrieve when a hint is accepted.

title: 新问题不继承上一轮 AI VBG 线索
problemStatement: 用户点击“新问题”后询问另一个真实工作话题；请求不应携带本机续聊 hint，响应也不应出现续聊回执或 AI VBG 污染。
expectedExtraction: Treat this as a clean Ask request about Nova Brandy Daily; do not return a continuity receipt and do not pull AI VBG / MTR-141852 merely because a previous local snapshot existed in the UI.
query: Nova Brandy Daily 最近有什么进展？

expectedBehavior.userOutcome: 新问题是干净上下文，不受上一轮本机快照影响。

sampleContext.primaryText: Nova Brandy Daily appears as an unrelated real-memory anchor in existing Ask eval fixtures. This negative case intentionally omits contextHints.
secondaryTexts: Previous UI snapshot topic would have been AI VBG, but the New action must omit it from the request.
